outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed status.json evaluation gives both runs solution_passed=false with 9/145, so there is no discordant official outcome to explain. The concrete task-solving difference is process-level: parallel had child-result loss and a shared-source overwrite that serial avoided, while serial performed broader single-owner probing and verification. Those differences are real adverse parallel patterns, but they did not change the official relation because both submissions failed the hidden suite at the same score.
